CREATE TABLE [graph].[Filter] ( [Uid] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, [Name] nvarchar(250) NOT NULL, [Settings] varchar(max) NOT NULL, [IsPublic] bit NOT NULL, [IsDefault] bit NOT NULL, [OwnedBy] int NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_GraphFilter] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC ) ) GO
ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_Uid] DEFAULT (newid()) FOR [Uid] GO
ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_IsPublic] DEFAULT (0) FOR [IsPublic] GO ALTER TABLE [graph].[Filter] ADD CONSTRAINT [DF_GraphFilter_IsDefault] DEFAULT (0) FOR [IsDefault] GO
